method_matrix.hypothesis: Correct labels and verified timestamps are prerequisites for directional inference.
method_matrix.evidence: The source-quality report records official-close discrepancies and no accepted independent 10:00 anchor.
method_matrix.next_action: Reconcile row-level 10:00 anchor prices against a genuinely independent source and explain the daily-close mismatch.

method_matrix.family: Multiscale trend, gap, range and volatility interactions
method_matrix.hypothesis: Trend strength and reversal features conditional on volatility may add information beyond the current weekly-cycle features.
method_matrix.evidence: The current table has ret_1/5/10/20, rv_5/10/20, range_5/10/20, overnight_gap, pre_anchor_return and anchor_jump.
method_matrix.next_action: After source acceptance, add causal ratios and interactions, then compare nested walk-forward ablations.

method_matrix.family: India VIX and conditional volatility state
method_matrix.hypothesis: Directional effects may vary across volatility regimes; volatility alone is not assumed to predict direction.
method_matrix.evidence: No verified point-in-time India VIX series is joined to the current weekly feature table.
method_matrix.next_action: Acquire official VIX history, align availability times, and compute fold-local state/rank features.

method_matrix.hypothesis: ATM IV, skew, term structure, straddle-implied move and OI changes may add information beyond spot OHLC.
method_matrix.evidence: No historical 10:00 option-chain snapshot table is currently linked to the labelled rows. End-of-day OI cannot be backdated to the 10:00 forecast.
method_matrix.next_action: Inspect selective Zenodo/Hugging Face partitions and Dhan history; validate contracts, timestamps, rights and missingness.

method_matrix.hypothesis: Overnight global price discovery may help explain NIFTY movement from 10:00 to expiry close.
method_matrix.evidence: No timestamp-audited GIFT NIFTY, US/Asia, FX or commodity panel is joined to the labelled rows.
method_matrix.next_action: Build a lag-safe panel with market-specific timezones, holidays, closes and publication-time metadata.

method_matrix.hypothesis: Lagged flow, positioning or breadth measures may explain conditional weekly direction.
method_matrix.evidence: A verified point-in-time flow/participant table is not joined to the current feature table.
method_matrix.next_action: Use the last report actually published by the forecast cutoff; do not use post-close information at 10:00.

method_matrix.family: Fold-local regime models and change-point features
method_matrix.hypothesis: Transparent volatility state labels or regime interactions may improve stability over one global estimator.
method_matrix.evidence: The weekly sample is approximately 400 cycles and current source quality blocks model fitting or tuning.
method_matrix.next_action: Start with simple development-fold volatility thresholds and regularised interactions before complex hidden-state models.

method_matrix.hypothesis: Uncertainty estimates may improve selective decision quality by abstaining on ambiguous cycles.
method_matrix.evidence: Current holdout probabilities are exploratory; sequential coverage has not been accepted.
method_matrix.next_action: Calibrate inside development folds and measure sequential uncertainty coverage/abstention versus error.

method_matrix.family: PySR symbolic and Quantevolve-inspired bounded search
method_matrix.hypothesis: A compact formula may reveal an interpretable interaction missed by fixed features.
method_matrix.evidence: The experiment registry explicitly lists PySR and Quantevolve searches as not run.
method_matrix.next_action: Only after source acceptance: cap at 100 candidate expressions/rules and up to 3 development-only generations, with complexity controls and a complete registry.

method_matrix.family: LLM news agents and deep sequence models
method_matrix.hypothesis: Potential value depends on richer, correctly timestamped inputs than the current weekly sample contains.
method_matrix.evidence: About 398 weekly rows are not a sound basis for unrestricted neural sequence search.
method_matrix.next_action: Use LLMs only to propose auditable hypotheses; defer deep sequence models until a larger, independently validated sample exists.

experiment_registry.interpretation: Not-run means no empirical conclusion; it must not be reported as a failed or underperforming model.

guardrail: This readiness audit did not train or select any candidate estimator.
next_gate: Independent 10:00 anchor validation and official-close/source discrepancy investigation must pass; then rebuild labels and freeze a new split manifest.
